findings.claim: The authorization callback can send raw session credentials over plaintext HTTP to any configured host.
findings.evidence: authorize forwards Cookie, Authorization, or X-Session-Token at lines 24-35, while callback_url accepts both http and https at lines 48-59 without an explicit development opt-in or host restriction.
findings.suggested_fix: Require HTTPS by default and permit HTTP only through an explicit insecure-development setting restricted to loopback or the intended local Docker host.
